verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh can run headlessly through its own API. It documents API credentials with configurable permissions and expiry, a downloadable OpenAPI schema and Postman collection, synchronous, asynchronous and batch screening, and webhook-driven result handling, so automated jobs can work without the web UI. However, nothing documents CI pipeline use specifically, and there is no CLI, so the 'in CI' part of the story is only implied. missing for 10: official CLI or CI-runner integration docs (e.g. pipeline examples or a sandbox/test environment for CI), hands-on or independent corroboration of authenticated headless operation (the probe only retrieved documentation).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: These can be generated in the ComplyAdvantage Mesh web application under Settings > Access Management > API Credentials, where you can also configure their permissions and optional expiry date.
ComplyAdvantage offers a Postman collection to help you on your integration journey
For high-volume processing, use the Batch Processing API.
Cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated either via the ComplyAdvantage Mesh web application or by integrating with the API for use in your own case management system.
